Huge congratulations! That is an incredible achievement. After eight months of the "application grind," it is completely normal to feel exhausted rather than energized.

Since you want to acknowledge the win without the exhaustion of a big event, here are a few ways to "celebrate" in a low-energy way tonight:

1. The "Luxury" Night In
Order your favorite takeout (the fancy stuff you usually don't get), put on your most comfortable pajamas, and watch a movie or show you’ve been wanting to see. The goal is to treat yourself to comfort.

2. The "One Small Toast"
If you have a partner or a close friend who knows how hard you worked, have them pour you a glass of your favorite drink (or a fancy soda) and just sit with you for 10 minutes. You don't have to go out; you just need to acknowledge the win out loud.

3. The "Future You" Prep
Sometimes the best way to celebrate is to give your "future self" a gift. Lay out your clothes for your first day, organize your desk, or just write a small "To Do" list of the fun things you want to do once you get your first paycheck.

4. The "Delayed Celebration"
Give yourself permission to do nothing tonight. Tell everyone, "I'm so excited, but I'm officially 'peopled out' and need to recharge. I'd love to do a proper celebration once I've settled into the new rhythm."

You did the hard work. You earned the right to rest. Enjoy this feeling of relief—it's a huge victory!
